headline: Joint workshop on the November tax cap vote, HB1331 actions, town budget and tax rate, and the 2027 school warrant.
summary: The meeting starts with a joint workshop with the Town Council on tax, budget, and school funding topics. The regular meeting includes a first reading of a generative artificial intelligence policy and committee reports.
items: Opening remarks for the joint workshop
Open discussion on the November tax cap vote and HB1331 actions
Town budgeting and tax rate
School District 2027 warrant and future projects
Coordination of town and school capital project timing
Future legislation from state legislators
State funding picture for the school district
Town and school collective purchasing opportunities
Other workshop topics
Director reports
Public comments from residents, parents, and employees, up to 3 minutes each for 30 minutes
Pinkerton Academy student update
New Hampshire School Boards Association Delegate Assembly
Business administrator's update
Superintendent's update
Communications committee report
Policy EHAG, Generative Artificial Intelligence, first reading
Curriculum and assessment committee report
Member updates and other business
Possible nonpublic session under RSA 91-A:3, II
location: Derry Municipal Center, 3rd Floor Meeting Room, 14 Manning Street, Derry, New Hampshire 03038
